study type: Mixed-methods (observational collection of human samples and in vitro experimental study)
outcome: LOX-1 expression in placental explant tissue
cohort: Placentas were collected from preterm pregnancies and cases of preterm preeclampsia and fetal growth restriction; blood was collected from participants whose pregnancies were complicated by preterm fetal growth restriction and/or preeclampsia; primary cytotrophoblast and placental explant tissue were cultured for in vitro experiments.
finding: LOX-1 expression was reduced in placentas from preterm preeclampsia cases and in hypoxic cytotrophoblast, and esomeprazole or lansoprazole treatment increased placental LOX-1 expression in vitro.
cross-section timing: Placentas were collected from preterm pregnancies (likely at delivery); blood was collected from participants during pregnancies complicated by preterm FGR and/or preeclampsia.
